presentation.label: Digi Perform
presentation.summary: Eight performance macros on knobs A-H: each moves one track parameter, per pattern.
presentation.overview: Digi Perform adds a performance page to the original Digitakt, modelled on the Analog Four's performance macros. The page is a second page of the TRIG page (press TRIG again); the assignments are made in SETTINGS > PERFORM EDIT, or on the page itself with FUNC and a knob's push. Knobs A-H each move one parameter of one track. A knob spans the parameter's own range, 0-127 for most and shorter for lists such as the filter type, and picks up the parameter's current value when the page opens, so it never jumps. The eight assignments live in the pattern, so each pattern has its own and they are saved with the project. The change is added after the engine has smoothed and modulated the parameter, so it is never a parameter lock and never changes the stored value: leaving the page, opening the edit view or reloading the pattern puts the parameter back to what the sound stores.
highlights: Eight macros on knobs A-H, each moving one track parameter.
Each assignment picks a track, one of the sound's parameters on the LFO, SRC, filter and AMP pages, and a direction, + or -.
Each knob spans its parameter's own range and picks up its current value, so nothing jumps; pushing a knob while turning it goes in larger steps.
Looks like the MIDI CC page: round knobs with the track's number in them and the parameter's name under, which becomes its value while turning; the header shows Name=value too.
FUNC + NO on the page reloads the pattern the stock way and the knobs pick up the saved values again.
Stored in the pattern's kit and saved with the project.
A parameter of a track can be assigned to one knob only; the knobs skip the ones already taken.
usage: Assign a macro to a filter on several tracks and sweep them together while playing.
Build a transition: one knob raising reverb sends and lowering the amp volume on chosen tracks.
Copy a finished macro setup to every pattern before a set.

access.location: TRIG page, press TRIG again; assignments in SETTINGS > PERFORM EDIT
steps: On the TRIG page press TRIG again to open the performance page. Hold FUNC and push an empty knob, turn it to choose the track (1-8 or ALL) and push; turn to choose the parameter and push. NO cancels.
Turn a knob to move its parameter. FUNC and a push on an assigned knob removes it. SETTINGS > PERFORM EDIT lists all eight knobs and sets each one's direction.
A tap of TRIG leaves the page, as does any other page key.

controls.name: TRIG, pressed again on the TRIG page
controls.doc: Opens the performance page over the TRIG page. Press TRIG again, or SRC, FLTR, AMP, LFO or a menu key, to leave. The trig keys, transport, FUNC, TRK and PAGE keep working under it.

controls.name: Knobs A-H (play view)
controls.doc: Move the knob's parameter over its range. Each knob starts at the parameter's current value, so nothing jumps. The knob shows the value for a second after it moves. Push and turn for larger steps. Leaving the page puts every parameter back.

controls.name: FUNC + a knob's push (play view)
controls.doc: On an empty knob, start assigning it: turn to choose the track (1-8 or ALL), push, turn to choose the parameter, push. NO cancels. On an assigned knob, remove the assignment.

controls.name: FUNC + NO (play view)
controls.doc: Reloads the pattern as stock does; the knobs pick up the reloaded values again.

controls.name: UP / DOWN or LEVEL (edit view)
controls.doc: Choose a row; the one under the cursor is shown inverted.

controls.name: YES or a knob's second push (edit view)
controls.doc: Make an assignment (track 1, FLT.FREQ, +) when the row is empty, or remove it. A first push on a knob only selects its row.

controls.name: Knob A (edit view)
controls.doc: The track whose parameter moves, 1-8, then ALL: the same offset on every audio track.

controls.name: Knob B (edit view)
controls.doc: The parameter: L1.* and L2.*, SRC.*, FLT.* or AMP.* of that track (or of every track).

controls.name: Knob C (edit view)
controls.doc: Direction: turn right for + (the knob raises the parameter), left for - (it lowers it).

controls.name: Hold TRIG + REC / STOP / PLAY
controls.doc: As the stock pages: copy the whole page (all eight tracks and parameters), paste it over the page, or clear every assignment. The same key again undoes the paste or clear. Holding TRIG shows the values instead of the labels; a tap of TRIG leaves the page. Plain REC, STOP and PLAY work as usual.

controls.name: NO
controls.doc: In the edit view, back to the play view, or to SETTINGS if the edit view was opened from there. In the play view it puts any moved knob back to its stored value and stays on the page; TRIG or another page key leaves.

limitations: Cannot be installed with Digi Matrix: both keep their data in the same bytes of the pattern's kit and use the same hook site.
Parameters are the sound's slots 1-45, named as the Digitakt's pages name them; ranges come from the firmware's own table. FLT.DEL to FLT.ROUT are the filter's second page.
One assignment for each knob A-H; other mods that keep data in the same bytes of the kit (Digi EQ, Digi Poly) use only bytes this mod leaves alone.
Tested in the emulator only; hardware results are in TESTING.md when recorded.

claims: ui:TRIG page:second page, TRIG pressed again

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
